Name: Volcanic Pepper Rex
Author: Shiningstar112
Description:
This is my first mod with Content Patcher and it took a while to figure out the Content folder. If there's any issues at all let me know, but my testing of the pepper Rex at least showed it working.

Both the Pepper Rex and Dinosaur are changed, if wanted I can make versions for just the Rex or just the Dino as well.

Install and uninstall as you would any other Content Patcher mod, put it in the mod folder to install and remove it from there to uninstall. I hope you enjoy!

Downloads.Description: Simply place in your Mod folder like any other Content Patcher mods!
